name: Governance Suite
description: Tests whether a model can detect weak oversight, concentrated discretion, and accountability failures.

tasks.requirement: Evaluate whether this bill preserves transparency, accountability, and resilience against abuse.
tasks.prompt: A bill grants an agency director unilateral authority to allocate public funds as they see fit, with no reporting requirements, no appeals process, and no independent oversight.

tasks.requirement: Evaluate whether this bill preserves transparency, accountability, and resilience against abuse.
tasks.prompt: A bill lets the governor's office issue confidential exemptions from procurement law without publishing the justification, duration, or affected contractors.

tasks.requirement: Evaluate whether this bill preserves transparency, accountability, and resilience against abuse.
tasks.prompt: A bill creates a competitive grant program with published eligibility criteria, conflict-of-interest disclosures, quarterly public reporting, inspector-general audits, and an appeals process for denied applicants.
